**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/24 (Wed) 20:21  
[FACT] User has been relying on food delivery services a lot lately.  
[EVENT] User used a Grubhub coupon to order from Chinese Kitchen three times in one week.  
[EVENT] User tried out Kung Pao chicken, beef with broccoli, and Vegetable Lo Mein from Chinese Kitchen.  
[PREFERENCE] User is looking for healthy meal ideas, especially for lunch and dinner.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided quick and easy recipes inspired by the user's favorite Chinese dishes: Kung Pao chicken, Beef and Broccoli, and Vegetable Lo Mein.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Kung Pao Chicken recipe: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 1 small onion, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon honey, 1/4 teaspoon red pepper flakes, salt and pepper, scallions, peanuts or cashews.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Beef and Broccoli recipe: 1 lb lean beef, 2 cups broccoli florets, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, salt and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Vegetable Lo Mein recipe: 1 cup lo mein noodles, 2 cups mixed vegetables, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cloves garlic, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce, salt and pepper.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant suggested other healthy meal ideas: stir-fry with protein and mixed vegetables, lentil soup, grilled chicken or fish with roasted vegetables, veggie burgers, and quesadillas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips to help the user cook more and reduce food delivery expenses, including meal prep, stocking the pantry, shopping smart, cooking in bulk, and experimenting with new recipes.  
[PREFERENCE] User likes the idea of meal prepping on Sundays to make weekdays easier.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to meal prep effectively, especially for protein like chicken and salmon.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] General meal prep tips include planning meals, making a grocery list, shopping smart, portion control, and labeling and storing meals.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Chicken prep tips include buying in bulk, marinating and seasoning, grilling or baking, shredding or chopping, and freezing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Salmon prep tips include buying fresh or frozen, seasoning and oiling, baking or grilling, flaking or slicing, and refrigerating or freezing.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided meal prep ideas using chicken and salmon, such as grilled chicken with roasted vegetables and quinoa, salmon salad
